relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: The effects of BDNF are mainly mediated by the activation of tropomyosin receptor kinase B (TrkB), expressed in both the peripheral and central nervous system.

relationships.subject: TrkB
relationships.evidence_quote: phosphorylation at Tyr-816 mediates the activation of the phospholipase C-γ (PLCγ) pathway involving the engagement of type II calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase (CaMKII) and resulting in the activation of CREB transcription factor

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: BDNF-induced mTOR-regulated reorganization of cytoskeleton mediated by the upregulation of RhoA protein, cofilin phosphorylation, and actin polymerization at CA1 dendritic spines

key_findings: Review of bidirectional pro- and anti-nociceptive BDNF-TrkB effects depending on cell source, region, and route.
Cellular source of BDNF (neuronal vs microglial) in pain remains unresolved.
